summary: Captain Rugelfuss sends you after the Stonesplinter troggs’ leader in Loch Modan. Scouts have traced their attacks to Chieftain Grawmug, deep in Stonesplinter Valley. His death may break the pack’s resolve and help reclaim the King’s Lands.

sections.title: Decapitating the Swarm
sections.body: Captain Rugelfuss’s scouts have found that the Stonesplinter troggs follow a chieftain named Grawmug. Their attacks threaten the King’s Lands in southern Loch Modan. You are sent into their lair to kill Grawmug and his personal bruisers, in hopes of breaking the pack’s cohesion and stopping its advance.

sections.title: Into Stonesplinter Lair
sections.body: Grawmug holds a cavern in the southeastern cliffs of Stonesplinter Valley, with his trusted brutes Gnasher and Brawler beside him. The three pose a danger to a lone soldier. Defeating them could throw the remaining troggs into disarray and give the beleaguered Mountaineers time to fortify the roads and drive the beasts back underground.

faq.answer: Grawmug is the trogg chieftain leading the Stonesplinter troggs in southern Loch Modan. Dwarven scouts traced the organized assaults troubling the valley to him, and he keeps Gnasher and Brawler as bodyguards.

faq.q: Where are Grawmug and his guards located?
faq.answer: Grawmug, Gnasher, and Brawler are in a cave on the southeastern edge of Stonesplinter Valley in Loch Modan. They dwell deep in its recesses.

aliases: who gives defense of the kings lands
faq.answer: Captain Rugelfuss is the dwarven officer stationed at the Southern Guard Tower in Loch Modan. He oversees the defense against the trogg incursions and gives orders to protect the King’s Lands.

faq.q: Why must Grawmug's guards be slain as well?
faq.answer: Gnasher and Brawler are Grawmug’s personal enforcers and stay at his side. They must be defeated with their leader to break the troggs’ command.

faq.q: What happens after Grawmug is eliminated?
faq.answer: Grawmug’s death could bring relief to Loch Modan. Without him to coordinate their raids, the Stonesplinter troggs may lose their organization, giving the local dwarven militia a better chance to hold the borders and push the beasts underground.

faq.q: Why are troggs invading Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Troggs have long lived in subterranean chambers beneath Khaz Modan. Excavations and unsealed caverns have let them reach the surface, where they displace settlements and attack travelers on the King’s roads.

angles.text: As a dwarf, driving troggs from Khaz Modan’s ancient soil defends your homeland and honors it, keeping the mountain holds clear of subterranean scourges.
As an Alliance member, defending Loch Modan helps preserve the overland connection between Ironforge and the eastern frontiers and keep supply lines secure for Alliance forces.
